blocks.text: Catalytic converter chhatte (honeycomb) jaisi banawat wala ceramic ya dhati monolith hai (Figure 12.6). Us ke andaroni channels par zyada satah dene ke liye alumina ki tah hai, aur mehngi noble metals platinum, palladium aur rhodium alumina par phaili hain. Yeh metals teen redox reactions catalyse karte hain jo nuqsan-deh exhaust gases hatate hain: three-way converter nuqsan-deh CO, NO aur hydrocarbons ko CO2, N2 aur pani mein badalta hai. Yeh qeemti metals recycle bhi ho sakte hain. Reduction: 2NO(g) + 2CO(g) Pt/Rh par N2(g) + 2CO2(g). Oxidation: 2CO(g) + O2(g) Pt/Rh par 2CO2(g), aur C2H4 + 3O2 se 2CO2 + 2H2O.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne catalyst ko kai jagah 'Pt / Rd' likha hai. 'Rd' koi element nahi; sahi rhodium (Rh) hai, yani Pt/Rh. (Ethene ka muadla kitab ne 2C2H4 + 6O2 se 4CO2 + 4H2O likha hai; yeh bhi sahi aur balanced hai, sirf dugna likha gaya hai.)

blocks.alt: Catalytic converter ka kata hua (cut-away) manzar: baen taraf nikalne wala pipe, beech mein chaura dhaat ka dhancha jis mein shahad ke chhatte (honeycomb) jaise do monolith blocks hain, aur daen taraf dakhil hone wala pipe. Mote peele teer dikhate hain ke HC, CO, NOx neeche daen se andar aati hain, chhatte se guzarti hain aur oopar baen se H2O, CO2, N2 ban kar nikalti hain. Ek lakeer block ke andar ishara karti hai: 'washcoat with catalyst inside the monolith channel'.
blocks.caption: Figure 12.6: Three-way catalytic converter (kitab ki Figure 12.6 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Chhatte jaise channels ki deewaron par alumina ki teh (washcoat) hai jis par Pt, Pd aur Rh lage hain. Gases jab in channels se guzarti hain to teen kaam hote hain: NO ka N2 mein reduction, aur CO aur hydrocarbons ka CO2 aur pani mein oxidation. Isi liye ise 'three-way' kehte hain.

blocks.prompt: Catalytic converter ka bunyadi usool kya hai, aur kya hybrid aur electric cars mein yeh hote hain (Quick Check 12.3b, c)?
blocks.explanation: Garam exhaust chhatte mein alumina par platinum, palladium aur rhodium ki bari satah par se guzarta hai; metals NO ki CO se nitrogen mein reduction aur CO aur bina jale hydrocarbons ki CO2 aur pani mein oxidation catalyse karte hain, khud kharch hue baghair. Hybrid cars phir bhi petrol jalati hain, to un mein converters hote hain; mukammal electric cars mein engine ka exhaust nahi hota to unhen zaroorat nahi.

items: Chhatte jaisa monolith, alumina washcoat, Pt/Pd/Rh; teen redox reactions: 2NO + 2CO se N2 + 2CO2 (reduction), 2CO + O2 se 2CO2 aur C2H4 + 3O2 se 2CO2 + 2H2O (oxidation); metals recyclable.
